agents._chat: the phone app's conversation: edits notes as files; core commits each turn, so its note tools commit later
agents._librarian: tidies the notes in place; core commits the whole tidy as one commit
agents._port: a device someone talks to (hold to talk): anyone nearby can use it, so it must not look or listen through the devices
agents._ha: Home Assistant through ha-mcp (docs/ha.md), left out while KKACHI_HA_MCP_URL is unset. The chat gets the everyday tools only: all 77 are about 70k tokens every turn. A device on the 전체 setting gets the chat's tools, the 제한 setting none of these
